w: At 6.10 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Botad for the grand finale of the decennial inauguration anniversary of the Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir. The 3-day program included a yagna for world peace, a spectacular procession on the streets of Botad, cultural programs, discourses and a concert of bhajans by the sadhus. This morning Pujya Mahant Swami had performed the murti-pratishtha ceremony of marble murtis of Guru parampara at the mandir. In the evening Swamishri worshipped the murtis of Akshar and Purushottam, Harikrishna Maharaj and the newly installed murtis of Guru parampara. Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees. More than 10,000 devotees had assembled on this final day.

This morning Swamishri participated in a maha-puja at the industrial estate of Ghanshyambhai Pagrani and blessed the assembly. Swamishri and the accompanying sadhus were also honored by the local devotees.

In the evening, a special assembly of invited members of the Indian Association of Dubai was arranged by Shri Bharat Shah - leader of the Indian Community and Shri Sunil Bhatia, Ashok Kotecha, etc. The Indian Ambassador HE K.C.Singh, the Indian Consul General Shri Ashok Mukherji and more than 750 people were present in the function. Dignitaries and guest speakers appreciated the BAPS earthquake relief work in Kutch and Saurashtra. Finally, Swamishri blessed the esteemed gathering, "... As long as we have not realized our atma then all our endeavors are worthless. We strive to acquire happiness through mundane means but fail. Only the experience of God can provide happiness. If one understands God to be the source of happiness then one's goal can be attained. The experience of God and atma will unshackle one from mundane attachments and desires and provide mental equilibrium in times of calamity. " Here we find buildings are created from sand, whereas the earthquake in Gujarat reduced buildings to sand. The world is ever-changing. The happiness of body and wealth is also fleeting. God is unchanging and still. If one engages the mind in God, only then can it become still. The more one internalizes this knowledge, the more happier one becomes."

This morning, Swamishri blessed 18 children who had covered the distance of 10km from Tajpur village to Sarangpur by prostrating and rolling (gabad-yatra) all through the night from 11.00 p.m. The children had performed 7,692 prostrations to please Swamishri.

Since Sarangpur is a seminary for sadhus, the sadhus studying Hindi dedicated the day's program as Hindi Day. Swamishri performed his puja amidst a backdrop of the Indian national flag and a map of India with the words, 'My India is Great'. The sadhus sang Hindi bhajans in Swamishri's puja.
In the afternoon, before Swamishri, several sadhus fluently delivered speeches in Hindi.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Guru Parampara, Hanumanji and Ganapatiji for the hari mandir in Barvala.
10 to

The Shri Hari Jayanti Celebration assembly commenced at 8.00 pm. The stage backdrop was made up of scenes depicting the life and message of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. A giant cut-out of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj’s face rose above the backdrop scenes. The assembly was first addressed by Brahmadarshan Swami, who elaborated upon the principles preached by Bhagwan Swaminarayan in the Vachanamrut. Thereafter Shri J.J. Bhatt of Mumbai, advocate in the Supreme Court, addressed the assembly, “The former speaker talked about Shriji Maharaj, but I am seeing Shriji Maharaj here before me. Whatever that happened in the presence of Shriji Maharaj I believe the same process is happening here in the 21st century85” Then Viveksagar Swami explained the supreme glory of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Swamishri was honoured with garlands by senior sadhus and guests. Then the assembly was charged with devotion with the singing of a kirtan by sadhus, “Premvati sut jayo anupam85” In his blessings Swamishri said, “It has been 225 years since Bhagwan Shriji Maharaj was born. He came and liberated countless souls. He revealed his divine form, and inspired all to live a God-conscious life. The Gita says that whenever there is a rise in unrighteousness, God takes birth to destroy adharma and re-establish dharma. In this way Bhagwan Shriji Maharaj took birth in Kaliyug. The ignorant did not realize God despite seeing his divine powers. Ravan, though he was intelligent, did not realize Ram as God. Hanumanji is believed to be the most intelligent among the intelligent because of his unique bhakti towards Ram. He loved only Ram and harboured no desires for worldly things85 God, out of compassion, came in a human form so that countless humans could happily have his darshan and take refuge in him. Bhagwan Shriji Maharaj came and established ekantik dharma.” At 10:10 pm Swamishri performed the birthday celebration arti and thereafter rocked Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in a hindolo.

ds.t: Study first, the mobile can wait
w: Among today's meetings was a teenager who had come from abroad. He wanted to live and study in India. He had a house in Vadodara, but since his family lived abroad there was no one else at home. The other option was to live in the hostel and study. So he said to Swamishri, "I will study living wherever you say."
Swamishri said, "There is no one at home, so every problem will come up, from food onwards. Rather than that, live in the hostel."
Hearing this, a sadhu who had come with him said, "His real problem is an addiction to his mobile. He cannot live without it, and the hostel has a rule about it."

Swamishri said, "There is no need for it. First pay attention to your studies and concentrate on them; the mobile will be there later. So study properly what you have to study." Swamishri made his wish clear.
A young man came to the meetings and said, "I feel very afraid. As soon as I sit down to study my mind wanders and I cannot concentrate."

Swamishri said, "Why be afraid? Keep saying 'Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan...'. There is nothing wrong with you; you have fallen into a false belief. But keep courage, take God's name, and courage will stay."
A devotee phoned from America. He wished to give seva to the local mandir, but he earned very little.
Swamishri said, "Give a twentieth part. Your situation cannot be called good, so give seva according to it."
He said, "I already give ten percent."
Swamishri said, "Give a twentieth, so that your household is not troubled either."
Swamishri gives each devotee seva according to their situation.

ds.t: "Bapa, I do your puja every day"
w: A volunteer phoned from Ahmedabad. He said to Swamishri, "Bapa! Please bless my little boy." Saying this, he held the phone to his small child. The boy said in his baby talk, "Bapa! I do your puja every day."
Swamishri said, "Puja is of God, and everyone is together in it." Then, inspiring him, he said, "Study well. Do not let any bad habit come. Do not watch TV. Remember God and do bhajan."
